correctness.rationale: The verifier reconstructs all 120 permutations of \(S_5\), computes Ulam distance as five minus longest-common-subsequence length, builds the complete threshold graph for distance at least three, and exhaustively enumerates every maximal clique. The exact maximal-clique histogram is 60 of size two, 120 of size three, and 4020 of size four, so the maximum is four and the labeled maximum-code count is 4020. It then recomputes all six internal distances of every maximum code and finds all six equal to three. Finally, it constructs all 240 declared relabeling/reversal maps, checks distance preservation on every unordered pair, and exhaustively partitions all maxima into 24 orbits with sizes 60 repeated five times, 120 repeated seven times, and 240 repeated twelve times.
